name: Akiba Touka
source:
Class: 2-B

A serious girl who is also the class president of class 2-B. She is good at studying and dislikes doing sports because she isn't very athletic. Many students dislike her because of her strict personality, especially when it comes to upholding the school rules. While her parents want her to apply for university after graduating, Touka instead wants to attend an art school.

Despite her serious personality, Touka often ends up laughing at bad puns and she can be quite perverted. She is also concerned that her thighs might be a bit too thick.
